implementation:
import functools,hashlib,json,threading
from pathlib import Path
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
ROOT=Path.cwd()
class Handler(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*args):pass
server=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),functools.partial(Handler,directory=str(ROOT)))
threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True).start();runs=[]
try:
 with sync_playwright() as p:
  for name in ['chromium','firefox']:
   b=getattr(p,name).launch(headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox'] if name=='chromium' else [])
   try:
    page=b.new_page();page.goto(f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/index.html',wait_until='networkidle')
    page.select_option('#preparation-task','task:species')
    page.wait_for_function("document.querySelector('#classification-source').options.length===2")
    findings=[]
    for ref,total in [('zenodo:13255198',19962),('grodata:128035:1.0',4952)]:
     page.select_option('#classification-source',ref)
     assert page.locator('#classification-trees option').count()==total
     text=page.locator('#classification-status').inner_text()
     assert text=='WIP: selection can be saved. Maintainer source admission required by CONTRIBUTING.md',text
     assert page.locator('#classification-review').is_disabled() and page.locator('#classification-run').is_disabled()
     page.click('#classification-add')
     findings.append(dict(source_ref=ref,tree_id_options=total,status=text,summary=page.locator('#classification-summary').inner_text()))
    assert page.locator('#classification-draft-list li').count()==2
    page.select_option('#preparation-task','task:instances');page.select_option('#preparation-task','task:species')
    assert page.locator('#classification-draft-list li').count()==2
    runs.append(dict(browser=name,version=b.version,status='passed',sources=findings,drafts_preserved=True,preparation_blocked_pending_human_admission=True))
   finally:b.close()
finally:server.shutdown();server.server_close()
report=dict(schema_version='1.0.0',status='production-readiness-gate-validated',scope='Actual shipped production registry; no isolated admission override',
 runtime_lock_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'browser-prepare/classification-runtime-lock.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 source_lock_sha256=hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'scripts/classification/source-lock.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 implementation=(ROOT/'temp/classification/check_production_readiness.py').read_text(),runs=runs)
(ROOT/'evidence/classification/production-readiness.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(dict(status=report['status'],browsers=[r['browser'] for r in runs])),flush=True)
